scope: Complete TPKT/COTP TP0, session/presentation normal-mode association, ACSE AARQ/AARE with embedded MMS initiate, VMD-domain GetNameList, one domain-specific named-variable Read/Write, MMS conclude and ACSE/session release, all successful request/response layouts. Bounded runtime codec with BER definite lengths and structural repair.
example_validation: protocol envelope and length consistency; bounded runtime codec validates complete fixtures and exact field ranges; not live service conformance

execution_contract.field_when_repeat: generic when/repeat are static-only; exact Modbus multiwrite data/count repeat descriptors are codec-managed
execution_contract.dependencies: whitelisted operations only; scope and when are annotations
execution_contract.content_scalar_strategies: runtime uses AFL field projection; values/strategies are annotations for CONTENT scalars
execution_contract.runtime_encode: capability assertion derived from runtime support and message direction; never an execution switch
execution_contract.validator_build: non-BACnet runtime validation requires a C11 compiler (CC or cc), protocol_codecs.h and all five protocol_codec_*.c sources; no Python in StateAFL mutation loop
